text:
elaine: Heads up 1 PR up to reconcile quota behavior + pricing table wording. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991
elaine: Goals: clarify tier names in pricing table, add a tiny flowchart for burst credit depletion, and swap out the old SDK header snippet.
maria: thanks. For the flowchart, can we keep it micro (one svg) and also include an example timeline showing minute-level metering when burst is active? Customers keep asking how minute vs monthly windows interact.
kevin: I sketched a compact timeline and added a sample PromQL query we use in dashboards: `sum(rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total[1m])) by (customer_tier)`
kevin: also swapped header example to SDKv2: `X-Redwood-Usage: user="acct_123", units=150, unit_type="tokens"` and added a note to not paste live keys.
maria: good. Small editorial ask: rename 'startup' tier -> 'early' to avoid clash with product naming. Keep mapping in a note for historical names.
elaine: done. One tricky bit: the quota doc currently says "requests are throttled" when burst exhausted. We should change to "requests may be routed to fallback model or receive 429 depending on policy" to match runtime.
kevin: I'll add an ops link and the exact routing policy snippet. Also fixed a broken Grafana anchor that was causing staging preview to 404. docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4991--docs.redwood.ai 
maria: quick QA: can someone sanity-check the pricing table math? I updated the per-token rows and the example invoice calc.
kevin: checked. numbers add up. I also included a downloadable CSV example for billing preview.
elaine: perfect. Im going to merge after a final quick pass. If anything pops on the preview page ping me and I'll follow up with ops for permanent dashboard redirects. :thumbsup:
